### Changed
- **The no-connected-inbox owner check now weighs how many contacts they own.**
  Holding a Sales seat with no connected inbox is normal for someone who builds
  sequences but never sends them, so flagging every such user was noisy. The scan
  now counts the contacts each owns and reports only those above a threshold
  (default 25, tune with `uninboxed_owner_min_contacts` under
  `[<portal>.thresholds]`), and shows the contact count as the blast radius. A
  role mailbox that owns hundreds of contacts still surfaces; a colleague who owns
  a handful no longer does.
